'''Chapter 996''' is titled "Island of the Strongest".{{Sort}}

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "[[Marshall D. Teach|Blackbeard]] and a hippo are brushing their teeth together." - PN Ebi

==Short Summary==
[[Tama]], alongside [[Komachiyo]] and [[Hihimaru]], saves [[Usopp]] and [[Nami]] from [[Page One]] and [[Ulti]]. [[Yamato]] continues fighting against [[Sasaki]] to protect [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] and [[Shinobu]]; the fight is about to escalate when [[Franky]] rushes in, being chased by [[Hatcha]]. Hatcha smashes a hole in the floor, allowing Momonosuke, Shinobu, and Yamato to escape as Yamato launches an attack that takes down Hatcha.

In different parts of the Skull Dome, Law is searching for the Road [[Poneglyph]] in hope of learning the truth about the mystery of the [[Will of D]]. [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] and [[Killer]] are making their way through the building to the roof where [[Kaidou]] is, gathering as many weapons as possible along the way. As Kaidou overwhelms the [[Nine Red Scabbards]], [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] flies through the crowd towards the roof where he is.

[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s group is also making their way to the roof when [[Sanji]] hears something.

==Long Summary==
Inside the bathroom in the forehead of the Skull Dome, [[Ulti]] and [[Page One]] wonder what it was that attacked them before [[Tama]] grabs [[Nami]] and [[Usopp]] and runs off. Ulti demands Page One tear the komainu apart but he retorts for her to do it herself, which upsets her. Nami asks Usopp if he is okay, and he replies he is despite clearly not being so. She says that on the bright side, ''she'' is fine, which annoys him. Nami asks Tama how she and [[Komachiyo]] got to [[Onigashima]] and she replies that she snuck on board an enemy ship. Suddenly, the baboon [[Hihimaru]] appears and clashes with Page One as Tama asks for him to hold them off for three minutes. Nami becomes worried that Hihimaru may not stand a chance against the two Tobiroppo, but Tama tells her not to look down on his strength and that they can as samurai.

In the right-brain central tower, [[Yamato]] continues to blow away [[Sasaki]]'s Armored Division. They in turn continue to strike Yamato. [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] becomes worried for him and [[Shinobu]] asks Yamato to take Momonosuke and leave her behind. Yamato refuses, saying that [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] wouldn't do that. Sasaki starts to draw his sword and irritatingly tells Yamato that he finds it insulting he would say something like that to him while protecting 'dead weight'. Seeing this, Yamato's [[Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Okuchi no Makami|teeth start changing and becoming sharp]].

Before the two can start fighting, [[Franky]] arrives with [[Hatcha]] following him. Yamato recognizes Franky inside the [[Battle Frankies/General Franky|General Franky]] as Hatcha swings his club near Franky, causing him to bust a hole through the floor. Yamato remembers that there is a floor underneath him and grabs Momonosuke and Shinobu to escape. Franky asks if the two have been captured but they answer that they are being rescued. Yamato asks Franky to take care of Sasaki and that [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] put him in charge of protecting the two. While Franky doesn't know who Yamato is, he nevertheless accepts. As thanks, Yamato uses a move called '''Narikabura''', and fires a shot of [[Haki/Armament Haki|Armament Haki]] at Hatcha that strikes him in the head, defeating him. Sasaki orders his troops to chase after Yamato, who tells Momonosuke that he must live because he believe he is the one who will lead the world to the dawn.

In the second basement floor, [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Trafalgar Law]] defeats several guards and approaches a [[Poneglyph]] while thinking about what [[Donquixote Rosinante]] said about the name of "[[Will of D.|D.]]", and how they are considered the enemies of the gods. He also thought back to when he revealed his full name to [[Nico Robin|Robin]] at an earlier point, which surprised her. She appreciates the trust he has shown telling her this, but she can not give an answer, as despite her interest in the name, Luffy has no interest in knowing. Law realizes that in order to figure out the meaning, they need to follow the Road Poneglyphs. Sadly, the Poneglyph he finds isn't red, so he chooses to keep looking. He says to Rosinante that now he seeks to find the meaning of the "checkered life" he is meant to lead. 

On the third floor, [[Eustass Kid]] uses his [[Jiki Jiki no Mi|Devil Fruit]] to gather metal objects and asks [[Killer]] if he gathered enough. Killer answers that since they are fighting the world's strongest pirate, it can't hurt to have too much, which elates Kid. At the roof of the Skull Dome, [[Kaidou]] continues his battle with the [[Nine Red Scabbards|Scabbards]] and is starting to overwhelm them. At the Live Stage, [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] returns, but she says that she only plans on joining Kaidou up on the roof.  

Luffy, [[Jinbe]], and [[Sanji]] manage to reach the second floor of the castle with Jinbe telling Luffy that the roof is above the fifth floor. Suddenly, Sanji asks the two of them if they can hear that sound from the third floor. He focuses and hears someone speaking in a seductive voice.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Tama]] and [[Komachiyo]] take [[Nami]] and [[Usopp]] away from [[Ulti]] and [[Page One]].
**[[Hihimaru]] engages the two Tobiroppo.
**Tama snuck on board an enemy ship to help fight in the war.
*[[Franky]] and [[Hatcha]] arrive at the Right-Brain Tower, where [[Yamato]] and [[Sasaki]] are, just before Yamato is overwhelmed by Sasaki's Armored Division.
**Yamato began what appeared to be a transformation, [[Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Okuchi no Makami|gaining sharp fangs]], before being interrupted.
**Yamato can use [[Haki/Armament Haki|Armament Haki]]. He defeats Hatcha and escapes with [[Shinobu]] and [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] down the hole Hatcha made.
**Yamato is also aware of the concept known as the [[Dawn of the World]].
*[[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] finds a [[poneglyph]] in the second basement floor of the castle.
**He revealed his full name to [[Nico Robin|Robin]] at an earlier point.
**He also reveals his intent to learn the truth about the [[Will of D]].
*[[Eustass Kid|Kid]] and [[Killer]] are at the third level of the castle.
*[[Kaidou]] is overwhelming the [[Nine Red Scabbards|Red Scabbards]].
*[[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] reenters the Skull Dome and plans to head to the roof where Kaidou is.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Jinbe]], and [[Sanji]] reach the second level of the castle.
